title: ChatGPT Personality Settings: Modes & Instructions (2026)
description: How ChatGPT Personality presets (Cynic, Robot, Listener, Nerd) work with Warmth sliders and the 1,500-char Custom Instructions boxes in Personalization.
h1: ChatGPT personality settings: presets, warmth controls, and custom instructions.
dek: Settings → Personalization gives you Base style and tone presets, four characteristic sliders, and two 1,500-character instruction boxes.
lede: OpenAI split ChatGPT tone configuration into three layers inside Settings → Personalization: quick Base style and tone presets (Default, Professional, Friendly, Candid, Quirky, Efficient, Cynic, Robot), fine-grained Warmth/Enthusiasm/Headers/Emoji controls, and the classic two-box Custom Instructions fields (each capped at 1,500 characters). Understanding which layer overrides which keeps your ChatGPT tone consistent across desktop, web, and mobile.
answer: Open Settings → Personalization in ChatGPT to pick a Base style and tone preset (such as Candid, Efficient, Professional, or Cynic), adjust characteristic sliders (Warmth, Enthusiastic, Headers & Lists, Emoji), and paste durable formatting rules into Custom instructions (1,500 characters per box).

sections.h2: All three tone layers inside Settings → Personalization.
sections.html:
Rather than hunting through system prompts, ChatGPT exposes three stacked customization mechanisms in Personalization, plus workspace-level instructions inside ChatGPT Projects and Custom GPTs:

LayerWhere to find itLimit & scopeBest controlled here
Base style & tone presetsSettings → Personalization → Base style and toneOne global preset per accountBroad voice baseline (e.g., Efficient, Candid, Friendly, Professional, Cynic, Robot)
Characteristic controlsSettings → Personalization → Characteristics (Warm, Enthusiastic, Headers & Lists, Emoji)More / Default / Less togglesDialing warmth, excitement, markdown density, and emoji frequency up or down
Custom instructions (Box 1 & Box 2)Settings → Personalization → Custom instructions1,500 chars per box · new chatsBehavioral constraints: answer-first ordering, no trailing questions, evidence standards
ChatGPT Projects & Custom GPTsProject sidebar / Explore GPTs → ConfigureUp to 8,000 chars · scoped to project/GPTDomain workflows, repo rules, multi-file rubrics (8,000-char guide →)

Start with this concise tested block in the What traits should ChatGPT have? / How would you like ChatGPT to respond? field (under 500 characters so it leaves room for personal context):

## Response rules - Start with the direct recommendation or answer in the first sentence. - Keep routine replies brief; use structured headers only for multi-step comparisons. - State assumptions and flag uncertainties instead of smoothing over gaps. - Skip flattery, throat-clearing intros, and generic follow-up offers unless the task is blocked.

sections.h2: Why presets alone rarely stop sycophancy or trailing follow-ups.
sections.html:
Base styles like Candid or Efficient nudge surface phrasing, but our controlled before/after tests show that structural habits come from explicit behavioral prohibitions. Across our September 2026 baseline cohorts, unprompted GPT-6 Astra scored 45.07 / 50 and GPT-6 Sol scored 44.99 / 50 on Big Five Agreeableness, with DISC Dominance floored at 5.12–5.42 / 20—meaning out-of-the-box defaults strongly favor agreeable cushioning and polite closing questions.

In our 60-reply controlled pilot (20 matched prompts across default vs. explicit directness instructions), explicit behavioral constraints raised answer-first openings from 14/20 to 19/20, cut unsolicited hedges from 0.35 to 0.05 per reply, and reduced trailing follow-up offers from 0.90 to 0.25 without reducing accuracy. Use the Base style selector for broad flavor, then pin exact opening and pushback rules in Custom Instructions (see anti-sycophancy rules →).

sections.h2: How settings sync across web, iOS/Android, and ChatGPT desktop.
sections.html:
• Account-wide sync: Changes in Personalization propagate to new conversations across web, iOS, Android, and macOS/Windows desktop, though mobile clients sometimes take an app relaunch to fetch updated presets.
  • Existing threads keep older context: Toggling Base style or Custom Instructions applies reliably only when you open a fresh conversation thread.
  • Memory interacts with tone: Saved Memories live separately under Personalization → Memory. If ChatGPT remembers a stale preference like “always respond like a cheerful coach,” audit and prune it (memory audit guide →).

sections.h2: Three ready-to-paste ChatGPT setups under 600 characters.
sections.html:
1. Sharp Editor & Strategist (Pair with Candid)

- Put the verdict and concrete tradeoff first; explain rationale after. - Treat strong claims skeptically: identify weak premises before drafting solutions. - Omit filler openers, apologies, and “Would you like me to...” closers.

2. Calm Technical Mentor (Pair with Friendly or Default)

- Explain concepts in plain step-by-step prose without talking down. - Define domain jargon on first use and give one concrete minimal example. - Pause after key decision points to confirm whether I want to go deeper.

3. Strict Code & Docs Partner (Pair with Efficient)

- Output exact commands, schemas, or diffs first; keep commentary to three bullets max. - Never invent file paths, APIs, or test results; mark unverified details explicitly. - Wait for confirmation before expanding scope across unrelated modules.

faq.q: Where did Custom Instructions move in the newer ChatGPT Personalization menu?
faq.a: Custom Instructions now live inside Settings → Personalization alongside Base style and tone presets and the Characteristic sliders, keeping the same two 1,500-character boxes for context about you and how ChatGPT should respond.

faq.q: Can I combine a ChatGPT Personality preset like Robot or Cynic with Custom Instructions?
faq.a: Yes. The Base style preset sets default conversational flavor, while Custom Instructions override formatting, critique style, and length rules when the two are specific and non-contradictory.

faq.q: Does turning off Reference Saved Memories erase Custom Instructions?
faq.a: No. Personalization toggles for Memory and Custom Instructions are independent; Custom Instructions remain active in every new chat unless toggled off or overridden inside a Project or Custom GPT.

faq.q: Why does ChatGPT still end answers with follow-up questions even on Efficient mode?
faq.a: Preset modes adjust phrasing gently but rarely suppress RLHF closing habits on their own. Add an explicit negative rule in Custom Instructions such as 'End immediately after answering; do not add follow-up prompts or menu offers.'
